sources.title: Image Caption Generator using Deep Learning on Flickr8K dataset
sources.snippet: In this article we created a Image Caption Generator using Deep Learning on the Flickr8k dataset. We covered the entire process, from data preprocessing and feature extraction using InceptionV3 to training a sequence-based LSTM model for caption generation.

sources.title: Image Caption Generator using Deep Learning on Flickr8K Dataset
sources.snippet: This project involves generating captions for images using a deep learning model built on the Flickr8K dataset. The model utilizes a combination of a pre-trained VGG16 model for image feature extraction and an LSTM-based model with attention mechanisms for generating image captions.
